item.title: UNC System votes to approve first in-state tuition hike since 2017
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) – For the first time in nearly a decade, the University of North Carolina System Board of Governors voted on Thursday to raise tuition at several public universities across the state. item.title: NC woman found 24 years after disappearance charged with failure to appear on 2001 DWI
item.description: Michele Hundley Smith, who was found in North Carolina 24 years after her disappearance, was served a Rockingham County warrant for outstanding charges dating back to before she went missing.

item.title: Man arrested for attempted murder tried to use child as shield in Harnett County, warrants show
item.description: In a Facebook post made Thursday evening, the Harnett County Sheriff's Office announced the arrest of 47-year-old Lamar Charles Hopkins on three counts of common law attempted first-degree murder, three counts of assault with a deadly weapon with intent to kill, fire-degree kidnapping and discharging a weapon within an enclosure to incite fear.
